items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I saw him but I don't know him. [INTERVIEWEE] Don't be his uncle. Yeah. Yeah. He'd be a friend.

ctx.x: He used to play a folk song. Well, when he played jazz music, he didn't read the... No. No.

Is Chris's wife still living? Last time I heard from him she's living. He has a son too. I've never met him. You've met his son, haven't you? Yeah, I met his son. Yeah. That's his son. One called Jack.
Jack. That's right. Jack. I saw him but I don't know him.
